scripts.build: npm run build -w @cevra/project-ir && npm run build -w @cevra/contracts && npm run build -w @cevra/i18n && npm run build -w @cevra/application && npm run build -w @cevra/project-store && npm run build -w @cevra/media-ffmpeg && npm run build -w @cevra/transcription-faster-whisper && npm run build -w @cevra/desktop-host && npm run build -w @cevra/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cevra/project-ir && npm run test -w @cevra/contracts && npm run test -w @cevra/i18n && npm run test -w @cevra/application && npm run test -w @cevra/project-store && npm run test -w @cevra/media-ffmpeg && npm run test -w @cevra/transcription-faster-whisper && npm run test -w @cevra/desktop-host && npm run test -w @cevra/desktop
scripts.test:python: python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s engines/media-ffmpeg/test_python -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s engines/transcription/test_python -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run test:ci
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:host:build && npm run desktop:runtime:prepare && npm run tauri:dev -w @cevra/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:host:build && npm run desktop:runtime:prepare && npm run tauri:build -w @cevra/desktop -- --no-bundle
